Independent practice, not a NESA examination. This is a simulation of the 2017 syllabus examination format used for the 2027 HSC. It does not reproduce past HSC questions. Numerical and extended responses are self-marked after submission, as only a teacher can assess the working and reasoning reliably.

Content and assessment coverage

Working Scientifically outcomes PH11/12-1 to PH11/12-7 are integrated within the bank. Year 11 fundamentals are assumed, not separately allocated half the paper.
